description: Named workflow recipes — the system prompt renders these so agents know when and how to chain skills.

workflows.name: Full Rebuild
workflows.trigger: After importing new data, changing source CSV files, or modifying the engine
workflows.description: Re-runs the pipeline (engine + all analysis scripts) and rebuilds the SQLite database. Always run /db-stats after to verify the data loaded correctly.

workflows.name: Deep Analysis
workflows.trigger: When the user asks to investigate a pattern, date, or cluster in depth
workflows.description: Start with remainder-scan to find clusters sharing a remainder, then convergence to test if independent methods agree, then frequency to see if events accelerate toward key dates.

workflows.name: Pattern Discovery
workflows.trigger: When exploring the dataset for new patterns or unexpected connections
workflows.description: Cycle-finder detects repeating intervals, complement-pairs finds events whose remainders sum to ~1.0, mirror-symmetry tests chiastic structure around a midpoint.

workflows.name: Tag & Knowledge Audit
workflows.trigger: When organizing the knowledge base, enriching articles, or building a tag hierarchy
workflows.description: Analyze existing tags for clusters, auto-enrich articles with hierarchical tags, then rebuild the tag index.

workflows.name: Date Investigation
workflows.trigger: When the user asks about a specific year, date, or anchor point
workflows.description: Start with a SQL query to find events near the date, then run anchor-dates for clock overlays, daniel-490 for 490-year projections, and convergence to see if methods agree.

workflows.name: Data Import
workflows.trigger: When the user provides new data (CSV, events, or uploads)
workflows.description: Always snapshot first for safety. Check uploads folder, then rebuild to process new data and verify with db-stats.

workflows.name: Gematria Deep Dive
workflows.trigger: When investigating Hebrew numerics, sacred numbers, or letter values
workflows.description: Run gematria for numeric analysis, remainder-scan to find matching clusters, sabbatical-slots for Shemitah wheel positioning.

workflows.name: Cross-Calendar Analysis
workflows.trigger: When comparing events across different calendar systems or religious traditions
workflows.description: Islamic-overlay maps Islamic history onto the grid, am-milestones checks millennium boundaries, convergence tests cross-tradition agreement.

core.description: Infrastructure skills — pipeline, database, snapshots. Use these for data management.
core.when: Data changes, imports, backups, or database queries

analysis.description: Research scripts that analyze patterns in the dataset. Each auto-registers as a skill from the manifest.
analysis.when: The user asks about patterns, dates, clusters, frequencies, or wants quantitative analysis

content.description: Content creation and publishing — drafts, sources, taxonomy. Only available in instances with draft_manager.py.
content.when: The user wants to create, manage, or publish blog posts from research

utility.description: Helpers — uploads listing, research log, help.
utility.when: Checking uploads, logging research activity, or listing available commands

genesis.description: Platform management — only available in the Genesis IDE console.
genesis.when: Creating/managing platforms and instances, git operations, promoting templates
